Worksheet.name: ક્રોસવર્ડ પઝલ
Worksheet.concept: Basic mathematical concepts, puzzles (addition, multiplication, mixed operations)
Worksheet.description: Students of various standards could solve the crossword puzzle aimed at making them critical thinkers and enabling them to guess the probable answer even if they cannot solve the entire puzzle, since a crossword has given hints and they could also learn the technique of elimination of answers based on their previously solved values of other questions.

Worksheet.name: આકારો બનાવો
Worksheet.concept: Identifying shapes inside of other shapes
Worksheet.description: Class 3rd and 4th students who are being introduced to the idea of shapes, could be engaged with a small activity of identifying similar simpler shapes in larger more complex shapes. For example, students could identify how to triangles are there in a square. This would them develop a cognitive ability to identify underlying patterns in a much complex problem and solve it partwise.

Worksheet.name: લક્ષિતસીડી
Worksheet.description: This game can be played between 3 or more players in which each player throws 2 dice, the product of the two values are multiplied and that amount of ladders that player has climmed, this goes on until the sum of all the products does not reach or exceed the targeted ladders

Worksheet.name: ક્રમનંબરશોધ
Worksheet.description: The Number Sequence Search is a worksheet similar to word search. It has incomplete sequences and a number search box wherein the student has to find the following number in the sequence and then find and circle the sequence in that box. If they cannot find the following number of the sequence, they can find it using the number search box.

Worksheet.name: પૂર્ણાંક સંખ્યારેખા
Worksheet.description: It tries to explain the concept of positive and negative integers through a number line. It is followed by mathematical operations based on the same.

Worksheet.name: જોવો, ગણો અને સરખાવો!
Worksheet.description: The concept of basic percentages like 10%, 20%,etc are explained using shapes and fractions. The shaded triangles are identified and divided by total number of triangles. This is how percentages are derived. This is followed by a worksheet based on the same.

Worksheet.name: પરિધ
Worksheet.description: The concept of perimeter has been explained in a practical manner using a hands on approach. A measurement scale is required to measure the boundaries. The measurements have then to be added for finding out the perimeter. For measuring the same of a circle, a thread has to be coiled around the circle. The coil is then measured for deriving the perimeter.

Worksheet.description: Worksheets for each grade with mathematical and aptitude based questions

Games.name: કાર્ડ કસોટી
Games.concept: Basic concepts of odd and even numbers with addition and subtraction operations
Games.description:
The Odd-Even game with cards is a simple card game where players try to predict if the sum of the numbers on 
two cards will be odd or even. In the game, each player takes turns drawing two cards from a deck. If the sum of 
the two cards' numbers is odd, the "odd" side wins; if it’s even, the "even" side wins. For example, if the cards drawn
are 3 and 4, their sum is 7, which is odd, so the odd side wins. Players bet on whether the sum will be odd or 
even before the cards are revealed.

Games.name: સમજદાર વપરાશ
Games.concept: Basic concepts of profit & loss, operations, budgeting and finance management
Games.description:
A simple game where you manage your monthly budget using cards. Each card represents an expense like rent, food, or
 entertainment. At the start, you get a set amount of money. Every turn, you draw cards and decide how to pay for the 
expenses without running out of money. You must plan carefully to balance your spending, save some money, and avoid 
overspending. The goal is to finish the month with money left over. The game helps you practice budgeting skills, make 
smart financial decisions, and understand the importance of managing money effectively.

Games.name: ખજાનાની શોધ
Games.concept: Basic concepts of operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division along with the ability to appropriately interpret hints/questions
Games.description:
Treasure Hunt Math Challenge is a fun, educational game for kids in grades 1 to 5. Players solve math clues using 
number cards and basic operations. With quick thinking and mental math, they race to find answers and earn points.
 It’s perfect for learning while having an exciting adventure!

Games.name: એક પછી એક
Games.description: Divide the room into teams. Place math problems at stations around the room.

Games.name: રકમ મેળવો
Games.description: For the Given amount 2 digit number formed by 2 Flash Cards, Students need to give fake currency with various denominations

Games.name: જીઓબોર્ડ
Games.concept: Different shapes, perimeter, area and real life objects
Games.description:
Geoboard is an individual game wherein the student has to make objects or shapes using thread on the board given. 
Question flashcards are provided, which contain different shapes, real-life objects, and diagrams with perimeter or 
area and half shapes (complete the shape).

Games.name: ફ્રેક્શન ગેમ
Games.description:
Fraction Bingo is an engaging two-player board game designed to make learning fractions fun and interactive. 
Players take turns rolling the dice, moving their game pieces, and identifying fractions represented on the spaces
 they land on. If necessary, they simplify the fraction and place a bingo chip on the corresponding fraction on the 
game board. The objective is to get three chips in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to win. This game 
is perfect for practicing fraction skills in an exciting and hands-on way.

Games.name: સ્પિન એન્ડ કલાઇમ્બ
Games.description:
Spin & Climb is a fun two-player luck-based game where each player starts at number 1 and takes turns spinning 
a central wheel. The wheel determines whether they move forward (+1, +2) or backward (-1, -2). The goal is to be
 the first to reach exactly 10. If a spin would take a player beyond 10, they must wait for the exact number needed. 
The game adds excitement with unpredictable turns, making it a thrilling race to the finish!
